proposition_assessments.sanitized_support_excerpt: a nova declaração substitui a anteriormente transmitida para fins de registro das informações no SIOPE
proposition_assessments.assessment_note: FNDE explicitly states supersession for the same federated entity, exercise and period; the new receipt corresponds to the rectifying declaration.

proposition_assessments.sanitized_support_excerpt: Considera-se vigente a última declaração transmitida e recepcionada com sucesso pelo SIOPE
proposition_assessments.assessment_note: FNDE explicitly selects the latest successfully transmitted and received declaration for the respective entity, exercise and period.

proposition_assessments.target_proposition: whether Recibos de Transmissão can show a superseded receipt
proposition_assessments.sanitized_support_excerpt: apresenta sempre o recibo correspondente à última transmissão realizada e recepcionada com sucesso pelo SIOPE
proposition_assessments.assessment_note: FNDE explicitly states that the public receipt query shows the receipt for the latest successful transmission, not a superseded receipt.
